name: Kevin L Mannix

bio.statement: Mannix's pamphlet statement lists his occupation as attorney and State Representative.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 8), p. 49

bio.statement: His official biography page says he is a practicing business law attorney in Salem who owns the Mannix Law Firm.
bio.excerpt: Representative Mannix is a practicing business law attorney in Salem and owns the Mannix Law Firm.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, official member biography

bio.statement: His official biography page says he served 10 years in the House of Representatives in 1989-1997 and 1999-2001.
bio.excerpt: He served 10 years in the House of Representatives (1989-1997 and 1999-2001).

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, official member biography

bio.statement: His official biography page says he returned to the Capitol in 2023 as State Representative for House District 21.
bio.excerpt: returned to the Capitol in 2023 as State Representative for House District 21

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, official member biography

positions.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Mannix says he passed a law saving Salem-Keizer schools $42 million, directing money to teachers and students rather than state mandates.
positions.excerpt: Passed a law saving Salem-Keizer schools $42 million, directing money to teachers and students, not costly state mandates.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 8), p. 49

positions.statement: Mannix says he voted for new laws stopping tax breaks for data centers and preventing them from passing energy costs onto Salem and Keizer families.
positions.excerpt: Voted for new laws stopping tax breaks for data centers and preventing them from passing energy costs onto Salem and Keizer families.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 8), p. 49

positions.statement: Mannix says he passed a housing package that is expanding the housing supply for working families.
positions.excerpt: Passed a housing package that is expanding the housing supply for working families.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 8), p. 49

positions.statement: Mannix says he helped stop Salem's payroll tax of $500 per person and cut Oregon's death taxes.
positions.excerpt: Helped stop Salem’s record $500 per person payroll tax and successfully cut Oregon’s high Death Taxes.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 8), p. 49

positions.statement: Mannix says he passed multiple laws protecting victims of stalking and domestic violence and authored a measure that kept violent felons off the streets.
positions.excerpt: Passed multiple laws protecting victims of stalking and domestic violence and authored a measure which kept violent felons off of our streets.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 8), p. 49
